name: GemmaCoder3-12B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from google/gemma-3-12b-it (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A finetune of google/gemma-3-12b-it, not a new base model: same config.json, same 12.187B parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. No licence tag on the repo, repo created 2025-03-18. The card's own verdict is 'improves performance on the LiveCodeBench benchmark, but diminishes on other benchmarks'; MMLU (-8.5) is recorded below as the loss it is.
